Team —

As part of the QBR packet I'm pulling together, AcmeCorp is targeting an internal pilot for Nov 2 and a wider customer ramp Nov 16. I ran a quick dependency sweep and attachment includes the dependency matrix + proposed staged-rollout windows. High-level items: 

- Launch window: pilot (us-west) 11/02–11/09; staged ramp (us-west -> us-east -> eu) starting 11/16. See staged-rollout-windows.pdf.
- Critical infra dependency: Dedicated GPU quota bump (requested: +20% baseline, +40% burst for 72h). Owner: Marissa (SRE).
- Runtime risk: model compilation path shows sporadic kernel mismatches for long-context (>8k) sequences — could impact latency. Owner: Irene (Applied ML).
- Cutover plan: canary at 10% traffic for 6 hours, health metrics gating (p50 latency, p95 tail, error rate).

Please review the matrix and confirm the following by COB Monday 10/11:
1) Infra capacity commit (yes/no + which region)
2) Any experimental model changes that must be frozen before canary
3) Proposed rollback triggers (we need explicit thresholds)

Attachments: launch-dependency-matrix.xlsx, staged-rollout-windows.pdf

Thanks — will synthesize for the QBR exec slide.

— Soojin
